title: The face, close
logline: The face close: moss in the eyes, a lichen map on the cheek, the mouth a line. Whoever carved it is reserved. The page gives it the care the strip gave the dog.

panels.composition: The stone face filling the page: moss in both eye-hollows, a pale lichen spreading across one cheek like a map, the mouth a single worn line, the brow's tool marks. Drawn with the attention the Sundays gave the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a close full-page view of a carved stone face with moss filling both eye hollows and pale lichen across one cheek and a single worn line for a mouth, tool marks on the brow, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Close. The care the dog got.
